name: Anzus
cooked: Thanks, this is really helpful. Labelling the payment type on the confirmation screen, instead of expecting people to know it beforehand, matches what we see in support: most confusion happens at the moment of sending, not during setup. The point about repeating the Lightning recovery caveat in the recovery instructions is a good one too, since that’s exactly when people need it. I’ll pass both along to our team.
topic_title: Where should wallets explain the differences between on-chain Bitcoin and Lightning?
